\pmtitle{the number of Sylow $p$-subgroups is $1 \bmod{p}$}

\pmtype{Theorem}
\pmclassification{msc}{20D20}

\begin{document}
Let $G$ be a finite group and let $p$ be a prime. The count of the Sylow $p$-subgroups of $G$ divides the order of $G$ and leaves the remainder one on division by $p$.
\end{document}
